summary: [probe] Open-syllable nouns beyond the pinned 보라/카메라/오페라 are reported as imperative ~라, notably loanwords common in tech briefs: '- 이번 변경의 대상은 인프라.' draws prose.ko-ending; 울트라, 엑스트라, 마스카라 fall in the same class. brief-polish could name the class (a noun-final 라 loanword) rather than three words.
